reviews.title: AS2 hour: display
reviews.reason: Bounded AS2-only delivery with ordinary HTML5 execution. New implementations, expanded existing behavior and stale catalogue corrections are counted separately in docs/AS2-RUNTIME-HOUR.md.
reviews.limitations: Runtime-created AS2 clips: sparse depth placement/lookup/swap, duplication of drawing/matrix/colour state, target metadata, legacy bounds/point conventions, TextField aliases and existing uniform-format fields. Authored/linked timeline duplication diagnoses; no SWF byte/version fabrication, no rich mixed-format text. HTML5 20/20 plus Restart; source-family review, not individual conformance.

verification.decision: Reviewed exact AS2 declarations against owned source and representative ordinary HTML5 family results. No per-entry Flash conformance claim.

reviews.title: AS2 hour: platform
reviews.reason: Bounded AS2-only delivery with ordinary HTML5 execution. New implementations, expanded existing behavior and stale catalogue corrections are counted separately in docs/AS2-RUNTIME-HOUR.md.
reviews.limitations: Browser-backed NeoFlash System capability profile, IME composition listener registration, observed keyboard modifiers, Delegate and plain-object EventDispatcher via owned Rust broadcaster, getVersion/updateAfterEvent and AS2-owned stopAllSounds. No OS IME control, Flash identity, policy bypass, UI components, audible-playback or native IME input acceptance. HTML5 8/8, real key A and Restart; source-family review, not individual conformance.

reviews.title: AS2 hour: xml-data
reviews.reason: Bounded AS2-only delivery with ordinary HTML5 execution. New implementations, expanded existing behavior and stale catalogue corrections are counted separately in docs/AS2-RUNTIME-HOUR.md.
reviews.limitations: Bounded AS2 XML DOM, inert declaration/DOCTYPE metadata, parsed idMap snapshot, namespace lookup, LoadVars and XML GET/POST/header/callback integration. No DTD/custom entities, XML raw-POST navigation or ID-map live mutation. Existing Object/Array profiles exclude watch/unwatch/addProperty/native boxed primitives. HTML5 18 checks without failures including actual same-origin XML POST/response; source-family review, not individual conformance.

verification.decision: Reviewed exact AS2 declarations against owned source and representative ordinary HTML5 family results. No per-entry Flash conformance claim.
